seed.description: Procedural generation seed — globally unique; drives all sprite generation determinism.

rarity.description: Rarity tier assigned at generation time by weighted random draw: COMMON 60%, RARE 25%, EPIC 12%, LEGENDARY 3%.

petName.description: Auto-generated from species + color combination at row creation; derived from seed.

level.description: Derived level: MAX(1, FLOOR(totalTrainingActions / 10)), capped at 100. Updated on every training commit.

totalTrainingActions.description: Cumulative count of training actions; feeds the level formula.

lastTrainedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent training action. NULL if never trained.

ownerTokenHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the pet access token. NULL = unclaimed. Raw token is never stored.

claimedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the email-OTP claim flow completed. NULL = pet is unclaimed (guest preview).

claimIdentityId.description: Set at claim time. Enables GDPR erasure lookup.

reservedUntil.description: Set to NOW() + 24h when pet is generated for guest preview. NULL for claimed pets.

isBanned.description: TRUE = pet is banned from arena and removed from leaderboard.

bannedReason.description: Admin-supplied ban reason. Non-null only when isBanned = true.

bannedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the ban was applied. NULL iff isBanned = false.

generationMeta.description: JSONB vector with 6 generation dimensions: {body, head, colorPalette, accessory, rarityTrait, pattern}.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp when the pet row was created.

updatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the last mutation (claim, training, reservation, ban).
